text:
kelsey: Quick proposal — tweak next week's weekly triage call format to reduce time spent on low-priority backlog items. Idea: 30m total, split into 10m quick lane (fast fixes + owner check-ins), 15m bug deep lane, 5m action items & rollups. Who can trial the rotating owners schedule?

sasha: +1 to shorter quick lane. Can we make the quick lane pre-populated from the 'bug-docket' label so we don't spend time triaging in the call?

jonathan: Calendar note — if we shorten to 30m we should move the meeting 10m earlier to avoid overlap with product sync. Anyone blocked by that?

maria: I'm oncall Wed morning but can cover the new owner rotation on a trial basis. Need a clear owner handoff doc.

kelsey: Good call re: pre-populate. I'll add a short script to surface top 6 bugs:
```
# filters bugs by priority and age
python tools/buglist.py --label bug-docket --sort priority --limit 6
```

prashant: I can own the first rotation and prep the doc. +1 to moving 10m earlier.

sasha: can we add a rule: anything labeled 'hotfix' moves to the front of deep lane automatically? saves time.

kelsey: agreed. We'll trial this next Wed (same channel). Plan: update calendar, add owner roster, and post the pre-populated bug list 1h before the call. Volunteers: @prashant to start, @maria backup, @jonathan to handle calendar shift.

infra-bot: deploy notice — scheduled infra maintenance Wed 02:00-02:30 UTC, might affect test infra. :warning:

maria: noted re maintenance. I'll flag any affected bugs in the pre-pop list.

jonathan: I'll update the meeting invite now and add the new agenda snippet to the doc: "10m quick lane | 15m deep lane | 5m rollups".

kelsey: thanks all. If no objections by EOD today we'll push the change live for next week's call. :thumbsup:
